newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stroeve raises EPS forecasts for ING.
newsitem.headline: Stroeve raises EPS forecasts for ING.

text.p: Brokerage Effectenbank Stroeve NV said on Monday it had raised its earnings per share forecasts for banking and insurance group Internationale Nederlanden Group (ING).
The 1997 EPS forecast was increased to 5.15 guilders from 4.90 and the 1998 net per share forecast was raised to 5.75 guilders from 5.40.

"Given the conservative valuation methods, especially in the insurance sector, we still think the share to be undervalued and therefore maintain our recommendation of Outperformer," Stroeve said in a report written after ING's presentation to analysts.
The brokerage said ING's 1996 results, which were published on April 3, were far better than generally expected. ING's net profit jumped by 25 percent to 3.32 billion guilders.
"On balance, ING increasingly appears to have chosen a good strategy as a bank-insurer, with a strong accent on emerging markets," Stroeve said.
